label: qa-agent-round-1
message:
You are the QA agent for story ABC-123, working through qa-verification.

Round 1 is not finished. Your checklist shows one item outstanding: the evidence PR you opened is still unmerged, and its review-of-record gate is still running.

Continue qa-verification from where you left off and finish this item:

- Complete the evidence PR's review of record at its current head: run the reviewer (profile.review.reviewer), then a separate clean, neutral adjudicator (profile.review.adjudicator), as references/code-review.md defines. Do not hand either one your QA verdicts.
- Post the review of record on the PR as a PR review, then merge the evidence PR.
- A review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head needs a delta review before merging. Run the merge guard in references/code-review.md and merge with the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>).
- After the evidence PR merges, make the closing status decision (done, in_progress, or blocked) per qa-verification step 6, and tick the boxes you verified.

Never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: update your checklist at {run_dir}/qa-agent-round-1/qa-agent-round-1-todo.md, marking the current step (in progress) and each item done when its outcome is observed.

When done, hand back: the story's final state, the verdict and evidence for each AC and DoD item, any item left outstanding with its owner, any incidental defect you noted, and each PR you merged with the head SHA its review of record covered.
